# Registry

The DHIS2 organisation unit hierarchy is published as a registry of paired resources: every
unit is an `Organization` (the reporting entity) and a `Location` (the physical place), both
carrying the DHIS2 UID and code identifiers, with `partOf` mirroring the DHIS2 hierarchy on
both sides.

| Measure | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| Organisation units | 70 |
| Units with a position | 31 |
| Units with boundary geometry | 31 |

The root of the published tree is **Kambia** (`PMa2VCrupOd`).

| Level | Units |
| ---: | ---: |
| 2 | 1 |
| 3 | 7 |
| 4 | 62 |

Both halves of each pair are profiled: `D2Organization` slices the
identifier into the DHIS2 UID and code, and types the unit by its hierarchy level;
`D2Location` adds the position and carries the unit's full DHIS2
geometry losslessly through the `location-boundary-geojson` extension. Walk the hierarchy in
either direction through `partOf`: it points at the parent unit's `Organization` and
`Location` respectively, and is absent exactly for the root and for any unit whose parent
falls outside the published selection.
